description: Every Obsidian CLI feature, plus protocol-aware frontmatter enforcement, instant offline FTS5 search, and token-efficient agent reads no other Obsidian tool ships.

tools.name: rest_active
tools.description: Read the file currently open in the Obsidian editor via the Local REST API plugin. Returns the note's path and full markdown body. Requires the Obsidian app running with the Local REST API plugin enabled and OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN set. Use this when an agent needs to inspect the user's current editor context; prefer `note read` for arbitrary vault paths without the plugin.

tools.name: rest_append-active
tools.description: Append text to the file currently open in the Obsidian editor via the Local REST API plugin. Required: text. Returns the updated note. Use this for transcript ingest or quick capture when the user has the target note open; for arbitrary daily-note appends prefer `daily append`, which resolves the daily path itself and creates the note from a protocol template if missing.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to append to the active file.

tools.name: rest_commands
tools.description: List every command id available in the running Obsidian app via the Local REST API plugin. Returns the command palette as JSON (command id + display name) — agents use this to look up command ids before invoking `rest exec-command`. Requires the Obsidian app running with the coddingtonbear/obsidian-local-rest-api community plugin enabled and OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN set.

tools.name: rest_delete-active
tools.description: Delete the file currently open in the Obsidian editor via the Local REST API plugin. Destructive — no soft-delete or trash. Returns 200 on success. Requires the Obsidian app running with the plugin enabled and OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN set. Prompt the user before invoking unless the agent has explicit destructive consent.

tools.name: rest_exec-command
tools.description: Execute an Obsidian command palette action by its command id (e.g. `editor:save-file`, `app:reload`). Required: commandId — get the list of valid ids from `rest commands` first. Returns a status acknowledgement; the command's effect happens inside the running Obsidian app. Requires the Obsidian app running with the Local REST API plugin enabled and OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN set.

tools.name: rest_ping
tools.description: Probe the Local REST API plugin to confirm it is reachable. No parameters. Returns a status payload identifying the plugin version. Use this before invoking any other `rest *` tool to surface a clear connection error rather than letting a downstream command fail with a generic dial error. (public)

tools.name: rest_search-simple
tools.description: Run a plain-text search through the Local REST API plugin. Required: query. Optional: contextLength (characters of surrounding context per hit). Returns an array of matches with file path and a context snippet around each hit. Prefer the top-level `search` command (offline FTS5, sub-100ms) unless you specifically need the live Obsidian process semantics.

params.name: contextLength
params.description: Characters of context to include around matches.

tools.name: rest_tags
tools.description: List every tag declared in the running Obsidian vault via the Local REST API plugin. Returns a JSON array of tag names. Requires the Obsidian app running with the plugin enabled. Prefer the top-level `tag list` command for offline reads against the synced SQLite store; use this when you need the live in-app tag set rather than the indexed snapshot.
